description: How to cite a work of a project's register in a text you write: give its key or any identifier in any shape ('arXiv:2301.01234', a DOI or its address, 'MR1234567', 'Zbl 1234.56789', an ISBN) and get 'cite' — '[@KEY]', what to put in a page, a comment or a description — the 'reference' line a bibliography prints (with † while it is unchecked or disagrees with what it names), and its BibTeX entry for a paper. Use it rather than typing a reference out by hand, so every text names one row. When the register does not have it, 'found' is false and, where what you gave is an identifier, 'offer' says which: add the source with set_source (that identifier, a key and its title) before citing it. Anybody who sees the project.

source.description: The source's key ('IMP26') or an identifier of the work, in any shape.
